steps: 1. Equip the Blightreaper on any career.
2. Hit an armored enemy (Stormvermin) with light and heavy attacks.
3. Swing through a dense horde and watch how many rats each sweep staggers or wounds.
4. Kill several enemies and watch for the green spirits.
assertions: Armored hits play Greataxe-style impact sounds and effects (not fire or crowbill impacts). Sweeps cleave roughly twice as many targets as before. Kill-spawned spirits still chase you and convert green health to temporary health. The regression suite reports no FAIL.
Assert template speed 0.75, sweep cleave twice donor, hit applies the Hagbane dot, one spirit per attributed kill, power 600 or 900, no temper option.
